messages:
Alex: quick note from today's console review: the p95 card 
 feels cluttered when we add both heatmap spikes and range annotations. need lighter affordances.
Priya: saw that. my vote: replace full popover on hover with a minimal in-chart marker + single persistent legend flag. reduces occlusion.
Sam: agreed. for keyboard users we should show the marker on focus and expose the details in the bottom flyout panel (same pattern as traces).
Jordan: want to avoid adding another flyout unless it's consolidated with existing trace panel. maybe use the existing details drawer and add an anchor id.
Alex: good point. consolidate. UX proposal: tiny ring marker (4px) on spike, marker gets focusable with `tabindex=0`, pressing enter opens details in drawer.
Priya: mockup css: ```css
.marker { width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-warning); transform: translateY(-50%); }
.marker:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,51,204,0.12); outline:none; }
.marker.hidden { opacity: .25 }
```
Sam: also include an optional visual state for sampling suppression: a subtle diagonal stripe overlay on heatmap tiles + a compact pill in top-right that reads "Low sampling". click expands a micro panel with slider and quick explanation.
Jordan: copy suggestion for pill: "Low sampling — some short spikes may be hidden". Click -> "Adjust sampling or view raw traces". keep it concise.
A11yBot: accessibility notes: ensure pill uses `role=button`, `aria-expanded` toggles, the slider has labels, and any dynamic updates should use `aria-live=polite`. Add a skip link to jump to the drawer content for screen reader users.
Alex: motion: make fades honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. also, when using pulsing to draw attention to a newly detected spike, respect reduced motion.
Priya: what about color? markers must meet contrast when placed on dark heatmap tiles. propose using a white 1px ring around the colored dot if tile is dark (auto contrast check).
Sam: engineering note: keep DOM count low. markers should be canvas overlay rather than separate DOM nodes when there are many. but still keyboard-focusable markers need DOM. propose hybrid: render only visible markers as DOM, use canvas for dense render.
Jordan: we need telemetry: when users open sampling micro panel, log event `sampling.adjust_open` with source panel id. also gate default changes behind experiment flag.
Alex: next steps: Priya produce two mocks (drawer vs inline micro panel) + keyboard flow diagrams. Sam to validate feasibility and hybrid render approach. Jordan add telemetry ticket. A11yBot will run checklist.
Priya: I'll aim to drop mocks by Tuesday EOD.
Sam: will review perf implications by Wed.
Jordan: creating telemetry ticket now.
A11yBot: running initial axe run on current p95 card: 3 issues found (focus order, non-descriptive buttons, live region missing). Will follow up with remediation steps.
Alex: thanks all. We'll review prototypes in the design sync Thursday.
